lines.zh: 我小跑起来，骨头咔咔响。
lines.en: I trot, and my bones clatter.

lines.zh: 短腿迈得快，一步顶两步。
lines.en: Short legs move fast, two steps to one.
I hug my bow; it's taller than I am.

lines.zh: 沙地上有我小小的脚印。
lines.en: Small prints trail behind me in the sand.
I hop the stone and don't fall.
My skull is a bit large and sways as I walk.

lines.zh: 我跟着大骷髅的步子走。
lines.en: I keep pace with the grown skeleton's stride.

lines.zh: 箭袋在腰上敲得叮当响。
lines.en: My quiver knocks against my hip.

lines.zh: 我踩到自己的影子，吓一跳。
lines.en: I step on my shadow and flinch.
I keep off the road and walk in the grass.

lines.zh: 膝盖一节一节的，像竹节。
lines.en: My knees click along like bamboo joints.
I must hurry, before the sun rises.
I line my arrows up one by one.
The string's loose; I tighten it with my teeth.
I count my bones: twenty-three.
Someone is knocking stone far away.

lines.zh: 我蹲着，把木剑插在土里。
lines.en: I crouch and plant my wooden sword in the dirt.
The wind bends my fletching crooked.

lines.zh: 我托着下巴，听树林的动静。
lines.en: I rest my chin and listen to the woods.
My skull is hollow and echoes.
I grind the arrowhead; it won't sharpen.

lines.zh: 天阴着，我就敢多待一会。
lines.en: The sky is overcast, so I dare linger.
You're so much taller than me.

lines.zh: 你腰上挂着弓，跟我一样。
lines.en: A bow at your belt, same as mine.
Are you looking at the arrow in my hand?
Don't come closer; I bite.
Your boot is three of mine wide.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，我的头骨才不用仰那么高。
lines.en: Crouch down, so my skull need not tip so far back.
You're not here for my bones, are you?

lines.zh: 你的影子把我整个人盖住了。
lines.en: Your shadow covers my whole body.

lines.zh: 我认识你，你杀过我的同类。
lines.en: I know you; you've killed my kind.
What are you laughing at? I have a sword too.
One of my finger bones snapped.
It hurts, but I don't cry.
He hit me; I'll remember that.
My bow has been cut in two.
The bone split; I can still move.

lines.zh: 这一脚把我踢出去好远。
lines.en: That kick sent me flying far.
I dropped an arrow; leave it.
I need distance before I can shoot.
My skull hits the ground and rings.
My little wooden sword flew off.
That arrow in your hand, give me one.

lines.zh: 那块骨头，你留着没用吧。
lines.en: That bone is useless to you, right?

lines.zh: 你的弓弦真好，借我看看。
lines.en: Your bowstring is lovely; let me see it.

lines.zh: 我闻到了铁箭头的味道。
lines.en: I can smell the iron arrowhead.
That rattling in your bag, arrows?

lines.zh: 给我一根羽毛，我就能修箭。
lines.en: Give me a feather and I can fix an arrow.

lines.zh: 你手里那块腐肉，我不吃。
lines.en: That rotten flesh, no, I don't eat.

lines.zh: 我只要一支，真的就一支。
lines.en: I want only one arrow, truly just one.
Set your bow down and we'll trade.
I have only three arrows left.
You bumped me and my bones rattled.

lines.zh: 我个子矮，箭却射得到你。
lines.en: I am short, but my arrows still reach you.

lines.zh: 我抱着弓，被你撞得倒退三步。
lines.en: Clutching my bow, I stumble three steps back from your shove.

lines.zh: 我的弓掉地上了，捡一下。
lines.en: My bow fell; help me pick it up.
Your knee hit my skull.
I stumbled three steps before stopping.
One bump and my arrows scatter.
You weigh far more; that's not fair.
I grabbed the wall and stayed upright.
Don't step on my arrows; they'll snap.
Will you shoot arrows beside me?

lines.zh: 我这么小，没人愿意带我。
lines.en: I'm small; nobody wants me along.

lines.zh: 两个射手，能守住一个坡。
lines.en: Two archers can hold a slope.
If I die, gather my bones for me.
You're taller; stand in front of me.

lines.zh: 我出生的机会只有二十分之一。
lines.en: My chance of being born was one in twenty.
Don't mind my size; my aim is true.
Let's count the arrows in the sky together.
Would you wait for me to grow taller?

lines.zh: 有你在，我就不怕大骷髅。
lines.en: With you here, big skeletons don't scare me.

lines.zh: 我捡起地上的箭，还能用。
lines.en: I pick up the fallen arrow; still usable.

lines.zh: 这根骨头不错，收进袋子。
lines.en: A fine bone, into my pouch it goes.

lines.zh: 我捡了一根羽毛，做箭羽。
lines.en: I found a feather for fletching.
I keep the pebbles for hitting birds.
Someone left half a wooden sword.
I try to lift a whole bundle of arrows.
This coin is shiny; I want it.

lines.zh: 我捡起自己的肋骨，按回去。
lines.en: I pick up my rib and press it back.

lines.zh: 地上有块熟肉，我不敢碰。
lines.en: Cooked meat on the ground; I won't touch it.

lines.zh: 我把东西塞进头骨里藏着。
lines.en: I stuff my finds inside my skull.
A rabbit is moving over there.
Footsteps, heavy ones, and I hear them.
Someone has walked into my range.
A shape stands under the far tree.
That one has his back to me.
Someone on the slope, a clean shot.

lines.zh: 我拉弓的时候，它回头了。
lines.en: As I drew, it turned its head.

lines.zh: 有东西在翻我的骨头堆。
lines.en: Something is rummaging in my bone pile.
Two of them, or just one?
I catch the glint of iron armor.
It's coming straight for my quiver.
Someone's chopping wood, loudly.
I've got my aim: that one.
It's three times my size; still shootable.
Someone in the tree shade; I nock an arrow.
I draw the bow full and hold steady.
Two more steps and he's in my blind spot.
Wind blows right; aim a little left.

lines.zh: 我瞄他的膝盖，那里没甲。
lines.en: I aim at his knee, where there's no armor.
He ducks behind a tree; I wait.
The distance is still twenty paces.
The string cuts into my finger bones.
He looks up, now.
I crouch low and hide in the grass.
He thinks I have only one arrow.
I count his steps: one, two.

lines.zh: 背后的坡太陡，他上不来。
lines.en: The slope behind is too steep for him.
When he turns, I release.

lines.zh: 我盯的是喉咙，不是胸口。
lines.en: I watch his throat, not his chest.

lines.zh: 我蹲低，让草丛盖住骨头。
lines.en: I crouch low so the grass hides my bones.

lines.zh: 他往前一步，我的准星跟着。
lines.en: He steps forward; my aim follows.

lines.zh: 等他弯腰，我就放这一箭。
lines.en: When he bends over, I loose this arrow.

lines.zh: 我瞄他脚下的阴影，那里稳。
lines.en: I aim at the shadow by his feet; steadier there.
He's close; the bow becomes a wooden sword.
I jump and slash at his shin.
The wooden sword is short; I must get close.
The flat of my blade smacks his knee guard.
I cut across his fingers.
He kicks; I roll clear.

lines.zh: 这一下用了全身的力气。
lines.en: That swing used all my strength.

lines.zh: 木剑裂了，还能再砍一次。
lines.en: The wooden sword split; one more swing left.
I slip between his legs.

lines.zh: 他弯腰抓我，我砍他手腕。
lines.en: He bends to grab me; I cut his wrist.
I bite down on his bootlace.
Too small; his shoulder is out of reach.
I ram his knee to make him kneel.
After this blow, I run.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，木剑砍在他膝上。
lines.en: I lunge and my wooden sword hits his knee.

lines.zh: 他抓住我了，我咬他手背。
lines.en: He has grabbed me; I bite his hand.

lines.zh: 我从沙子里钻出来，很小。
lines.en: I come up out of the sand, very small.
This time it isn't an adult; it's me.
Only once in twenty is it me.

lines.zh: 我抱着一张比我大的弓。
lines.en: I hold a bow bigger than I am.

lines.zh: 骨头还没长全，就站起来了。
lines.en: My bones aren't finished, and I'm standing.
A rustle in the dark, and here I am.
I look up at the moon; it's huge.
The dirt is cold, and so are my feet.
My first batch is only five arrows.
Everyone's taller; I won't accept it.
I climb up out of the cave mouth.
This stretch of sand is mine.
I was holding a bow the moment I began.
Small ones have their own way of fighting.

lines.zh: 火星落在我骨头上，发黑。
lines.en: Sparks land on my bones and blacken them.
I fell from high and came apart.
Water fills my chest, and it is heavy.
The blast leaves my skull ringing.
An arrow stands in my shoulder blade.
Magic flashes, and my bones burn hot.
I don't hunger; I just lose strength.

lines.zh: 雷照得我的骨头全白了。
lines.en: Lightning turns all my bones white.

lines.zh: 一直往下掉，连风都没有。
lines.en: Falling on and on, without even wind.
